versions.changelog:
- Initial release of split-to-prs.
- Provides step-by-step guidance to split large or mixed changes into reviewable PRs.
- Enforces safety rules: no destructive git actions or pushing until user approval; always create backups before changes.
- Uses repository ownership info to group and align PRs with appropriate reviewers.
- Summarizes changes and proposes logical PR splits before execution.
- Reports back with PR details and ensures leftover work is tracked.
